headline: Pakistan reached 281-5 at the close of day one of the first Test against Sri Lanka in Rawalpindi on Monday, with debutants Tayyab Arif and Mohammad Taha both scoring fifties and Saud Shakeel 57 not out.

card.desc: Saud Shakeel 57 not out as bad light ends play early.

caption:
Pakistan end day one on 281-5 against Sri Lanka!
According to Arab News, Pakistan scored 281-5 on the first day of the first Test in Rawalpindi on Monday. Debutants Tayyab Arif and Mohammad Taha both hit fifties, and Babar Azam made 50. Saud Shakeel is 57 not out. Bad light stopped play 15 minutes early.
